verdict.rationale: Reflect's docs confirm direct import support for Evernote (ENEX), Roam (JSON), and Markdown files—three of the four sources named in the story—but there is no evidence of a Notion import path (Notion isn't listed among supported formats). The docs also don't detail how well structure, internal links, or attachments are preserved during these imports, only that the file formats are accepted. Missing for 10: Notion import support, and explicit evidence of link/structure/attachment fidelity after import.
